privacyPolicy.title: Privacy policy
privacyPolicy.intro: This policy explains how Logr processes personal data, account data, encrypted transaction records, technical logs, cookies, and optional analytics.

controller.title: Controller
controller.body: The controller of personal data processed in Logr is Piotr Wrobel. Logr is a private encrypted crypto transaction journal used to record transactions, calculate values, and prepare export-ready records.

items.second: The app is designed to collect only data needed to create and operate your account.
items.third: You should not add identity documents, health data, or other sensitive unrelated information to notes or imports.

data.title: Data Logr processes
data.body: Logr processes the information needed to authenticate users, keep account preferences, and store journal entries.

items.first: Account data: name, login, email address, authentication provider identifiers, role, timestamps, and display currency.
items.second: Transaction data: asset, operation, quantity, price, quote currency, commission, source, note, calculated values, rates, import history, and export data.
items.third: Technical data: session cookies, locale preference, consent status, audit logs, error context, and integration response metadata.

purpose.title: Purposes and legal basis
purpose.body: Data is processed to provide the Logr service, secure user accounts, calculate transaction values, support imports and exports, and improve the app with optional analytics.

items.first: Service delivery: account access, transaction journaling, PLN valuation, dashboard views, tax/export workflows, and profile settings.
items.second: Security and integrity: authentication, encrypted storage, audit logs, abuse prevention, and troubleshooting.
items.third: Optional analytics: Google Analytics is used only after consent to understand aggregated product usage.

security.title: Encryption and security
security.body: Logr encrypts journal entries at rest and separates account administration from journal content access.

items.first: Transaction entries and notes are encrypted before storage using application encryption controls.
items.second: Application administrators cannot read journal contents. Infrastructure operators holding both the database and encryption key could technically decrypt them during an authorized recovery operation.
items.third: Runtime secrets, database credentials, and encryption keys remain outside source code and are restricted to operational recovery and maintenance.

processors.title: Processors and integrations
processors.body: Logr may use external providers only where needed for hosting, authentication, analytics, exchange-rate lookups, tax validation, bank import, or email/contact flows.

items.first: Authentication may use email/password, Google, or GitHub depending on the login method you choose.
items.second: Rate, tax, bank-import, and market-data providers may receive the minimum technical request data needed to return the requested result.
items.third: Google Analytics receives usage events only after analytics consent is accepted.

cookies.title: Cookies and analytics
cookies.body: Logr uses necessary first-party cookies for sessions, locale, and consent. Analytics cookies are optional.

items.first: Necessary cookies keep you signed in, remember the selected language, and store whether analytics were accepted or rejected.
items.second: If you reject analytics, the Google Analytics script is not loaded by Logr.
items.third: If you accept analytics, Logr loads Google Analytics using the configured measurement id and IP anonymization.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You can manage your profile data in the app and may request access, correction, deletion, restriction, portability, or objection where applicable.

items.first: You can update profile details and display currency from the profile page.
items.second: You can delete your account from the profile page; confirmed deletion permanently removes your account, entries, imports, valuations, and notes.
items.third: For privacy requests, contact piotr.wrobel@quadrantive.com from the email connected to your account.

retention.title: Retention
retention.body: Logr keeps data for as long as needed to provide the account, meet operational needs, and preserve security/audit integrity.

items.first: Journal entries remain stored until you edit, delete, export, or delete the account.
items.second: Audit and technical logs may be retained for security, troubleshooting, and abuse prevention.
items.third: After account deletion, remaining operational backups or logs expire according to provider and maintenance schedules.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: Questions about privacy, cookies, analytics, or account deletion should be sent to Piotr Wrobel.

items.second: Include the account email so the request can be matched to the correct profile.
items.third: Do not send passwords, private keys, seed phrases, or identity documents by email.
